senses.gloss:
रजःकुण्ठ-मुख (खः-खा-खं)
a. Covered
with dust, filthy.

रजक (कः) 1.
m. A washerman;
clothes.
f. (की) Washerwoman.

राजक (कः-की-कं)
a. Ruling, splen-
did.
n. An assemblage of princes.

रजत (तः-ता-तं)
a. White.
n. A neck-
lace; silver; gold; ivory; blood;
a lake; a constellation.

रजनि (नः-नी) 2. 3.
f. Night; In-
digo plant; turmeric; lac.

रजनी-चर (रः) 1.
m. A
Rākshasa;
a ghost; a watchman; a thief.

रजनी-हासा (सा) 1.
f. A flower (Nyc-
tanthes arbor tristis).

रजस् (जः) 5.
n. The quality, passion,
or sensual feelings; dust; de-
sire; pollen; menses.

रज-सानु (नुः) 2.
m. A cloud; heart or mind.

रजस्वल (लः) 1.
m. A buffalo.
f. (ला)
A menstruous woman.

रज-स्तमस्क (स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
a. Affected
with carnal and dark passions.

राजित (तः-ता-तं)
p. Adorned; irra-
diated, resplendent^1.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

रजो-बन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. A suppression
of menstruation.

रज्जु (ज्जुः) 2.
m. A rope, a tie; a
lock of braided hair.

राज् (ङ, ऋ) राजते, रेजते 1.
d. To
shine. With निर to overcome.

राज-गामिन् (मी-मिनी-मि)
a. Going,
or reverting to the ruler.

राज-चिह्नक (कं) 1.
n. The male or
female organ of generation.

राज-जम्बू (म्बूः) 3.
f. A large kind of
rose apple; date tree.

राज-दण्ड (ण्डं) 1.
n. A sceptre; pu-
nishment by a king.

राज-दन्त (न्तः) 1.
m. An upper and foretooth.

राजधान (नं-नी) 1.
n. 3.
f. A royal
city, a capital, metropolis.

राज-धर्म्म (र्म्मः) 1.
m. Royal duty; duty
of the military tribe.

राज-धान्य (न्यं) 1.
n. A sort of grain.

राजन् (जा) 5.
m. A king
f. (जी) Queen.

राजन्य (न्यं) 1.
m. A
Kshetriya; fire;
a tree (Mimusops kauki).

राजन्यक (कं) 1
n. A number of
Khetri-
yas or men of the military tribe.

राजन्वत् (न्वा-न्वती-न्वत्)
a. Having
a good monarch or ruler.

राज-पट्ट (ट्टः) 2.
m. A gem; a tiara.

राज-पुत्र (त्रः) 1.
m. A prince; the pla-
net
Mercury; a
Kshetriya or sol-
dier.
f. (त्री) Princess; jasmin;
bell metal; gourd; musk shrew.

राज-बदर (रं) 1.
n. Justicia plant;
salt.
m. The jujube.

राज-भद्रक (कः) 1.
m. A sort of costus.

राज-भाज् (क्)
a. Belonging to the king

राज-भोग्य (ग्यः) 1.
m. A tree.
n. Mace.

राज-माष (षः) 1.
m. A kind of bean.

राज-योग्य (ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
a. Proper for
a sovereign, princely, royal.

राज-राज (जः) 1.
m. A name of
Ku-
vera; an emperor; the moon.

राज-वंश्य (श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
a. Of royal
parentage or descent.

राजवत् (वान्-वती-वत्)
a. Govern-
ed by a good monarch; royal.

राजा_वलि (लिः-ली) 2. 3.
f. Line of
kings; genealogy of kings.

राज-वीजिन् (जी-जिनी-जि)
a. Spring-
ing from a royal race.

राज-वृक्ष (क्षः) 2.
m. The
Piyāl tree;
Cassia fistula; Euphorbia.

राज-शन (नः) 1.
m. A plant from
which canvass is made.

राज-शय्या (य्या) 1.
f. A royal seat or
bed or throne.

राज-शासन (नं) 1.
n. Royal edict or badge.

राज-शुक (कः) 1.
m. A sort of parrot.

राज-शृङ्ग (ङ्गं) 1.
n. The royal um-
brella.
m. Sort of sheat fish.

राजस (सः-सी-सं)
a. Relating to pas-
sion or the state of those who
are sensual.
f. Durgā.

राज-सभा (भा) 1.
f. A royal assem-
bly or court.

राज-सर्षप (पः) 1.
m. Mustard; mus-
tard seed as a weight or measure.

राज-सूय (यं) 1.
n. A sacrifice per-
formed only by a universal mo-
narch attended with his tribu-
[]
tary princes; a lotus; a moun-
tain; a sort of rice.

राजसूयक (कः-की-कं)
a. Of a royal sacrifice.

राजसूय-याजिन् (जी) 5.
m. Priest of
the
Rājsūya sacrifice.

राज-हंस (सः) 1.
m. A flamingo; a
swan; a gander; a good king.

राज-हर्षण (णं) 1.
n. A city, a town.

राज-हस्तिन् (स्ती) 5.
m. A royal or
majestic elephant.

राजा_तन (नः) 1.
m. A tree (Bucha-
nania latifolia).

राजा_दन (नः) 1.
m. Idem; Mimu-
sops kauki; Butea frondosa.

राजा_र्ह (र्हः-र्हा-र्हं)
a. Royal, noble,
worthy of a king.
n. Aloe wood.

राजा_हि (हिः) 2.
m. A sort of snake,
said to be two-headed.

राजि (जिः-जी) 2. 3.
f. A row, a
continuous line; tubular vessel.

राजीव (वः-वा-वं)
a. Attending on
a prince.
m. A large fish; kind
of deer; elephant.
n. Lotus.

राज्य (ज्यं) 1.
n. A government, a
kingdom; administration.

राज्य-रक्षा (क्षा) 1.
f. Defence of the
state, saving of the kingdom.

राज्या_ङ्ग (ङ्गं) 1.
n. The requisites of
royal administration, as a king,
minister, treasury, territory, ar-
my, people, &c.
